lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: Oh, really?

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Yeah. The project is going to continue.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: Wow, what a relief. Your efforts weren't for nothing after all.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... Yeah. Right.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: There's been a change, though.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Before you deploy, you'll be receiving, um... an enhancement procedure.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: What sort of enhancement?

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: It temporarily boosts your NIMPH's functions.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: The, uh... the technology's still incomplete, so it can only be inject... er, performed right before deployment.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Also, you'll now be accompanied by a commander from the Ark.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: ... Huh?

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Yeah. Just so you know.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Up until now, we've just had you charge in without any real strategy.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: If you're getting an expert's advice while you're out there, you should fare better.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: What do you mean...? I don't understand.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: You don't need to understand.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: All you need to do is listen to your Commander and get to the target location.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: You've done this hundreds of times before, right? Just think of it as having another companion. That'll make it easier.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Now, off you go.
Maria-n hesitates, then walks off.
She enters a room that had been used for storage.
She sees a huge machine. She lies down and passes through it.
Maria-n gets up and checks the state of her body.
She doesn't feel any different. She doesn't seem to be any stronger.
She heads down the stairs.
The transport ship she's seen countless times is readying for deployment.
She walks aboard.
Her eyes meet those of a man she's never seen before.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: H-hi ther—

lines.speaker: No.1
lines.text: Don't speak to me without permission, Nikke.

lines.speaker: No.1
lines.text: Sit down. Be quiet.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: ... Huh?

lines.speaker: No.1
lines.text: Sit. Don't make me say it again.

lines.speaker: No.1
lines.text: And no questions from now on. A Nikke asking her Commander questions is ridiculous.

lines.speaker: No.1
lines.text: Just keep quiet and follow my orders. Got it?

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: Um, what exactly is going on...?

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: All you need to do is listen to your Commander and get to the target location.

lines.speaker: No.1
lines.text: I said sit! Make me repeat myself one more time and it'll be the last thing you do!

lines.speaker: No.1
lines.text: I'll have you shot for insubordination!

lines.speaker: No.1
lines.text: As your Commander, I have that authority!
Maria-n sits down without another word.
With a familiar vibration and sound, the transport ship departs.
She looks at the face of the man seated across from her.
He eyes her with cautious distrust,
an arrogant gaze that looks down on her.
Maria-n feels as though the view in front of her is growing dark.
The transport ship lands and its ramp door opens.

lines.speaker: No.1
lines.text: Get out. Scout a fifty-meter radius around the transport ship and report on any hazards.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: ... That's pointless. If there were any Raptures nearby, they would've attacked already.

lines.speaker: No.1
lines.text: Do what I say. I am your Commander.

lines.speaker: No.1
lines.text: Go. Now.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: I don't see what tactical value there is in doing so.

lines.speaker: No.1
lines.text: Who are you to lecture me on tactics? I give the orders! You just do as you're told!

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: But there's no reason to do something so stupid...!
*Bang!*
The man fires his pistol at the ceiling.
The bullet ricochets and grazes Maria-n's cheek.

lines.speaker: No.1
lines.text: That was a warning. Next one's going through your head.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: We need to get out now! Raptures will have heard that shot and be on their way!

lines.speaker: No.1
lines.text: What...?

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: Also, what were you thinking, firing a weapon inside a steel transport ship?!

lines.speaker: No.1
lines.text: Wh... what...?

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: Hurry! We need to get out!
Maria-n urgently sprints outside the transport ship. The man scrambles after her, flustered.
The two keep running, but before long the sound of Raptures' steps pounding on the ground draws closer.

lines.speaker: No.1
lines.text: Wh-what's that sound? Report!

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: It's the sound of the Raptures approaching...!

lines.speaker: No.1
lines.text: Sound attracts them?

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: No.1
lines.text: I never heard anything like that at the academy! You're trying to trick me, aren't you?

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: What are you even saying...?! Get down!

lines.speaker: No.1
lines.text: I give the orders! I'm the Commander...!

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: Ugh...!
Maria-n grabs the man by the collar and drags him down.
Just as they dive behind cover, rounds streak over their heads.

lines.speaker: No.1
lines.text: Eek...!

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: Are you armed? Don't tell me that pistol is all you have.

lines.speaker: No.1
lines.text: What? Wh-why would I carry another weapon...? Fighting is a Nikke's job!

lines.speaker: No.1
lines.text: I'm...! I'm the Commander...! I give orders...!
Maria-n leans out to check beyond the cover.
An influx of Raptures are advancing, concentrating their fire on them.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: I'll clear out those Raptures first! Encoun...!

lines.speaker: No.1
lines.text: W-wait! Not here!

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: What...?

lines.speaker: No.1
lines.text: Th-that's a machine gun you've got, right?

lines.speaker: No.1
lines.text: We should fall back to get into optimal effective range!

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: What are you talking about...?! This isn't the time for that! The Raptures are attacking as they close in!

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: We'll die if we move!

lines.speaker: No.1
lines.text: I make the calls! I am the Commander!

lines.speaker: No.1
lines.text: Let me see... There! We just need to secure that place! We'll have the high ground!

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: I can defeat them all from here! There's no reason to do that!

lines.speaker: No.1
lines.text: Shut up! You're a Nikke! Don't talk back!

lines.speaker: No.1
lines.text: I'm moving, so stay on me and keep up!
The man breaks from cover and runs.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: Wait, the signal!
Maria-n hurriedly steadies herself and prepares to move.
Just as she's half risen...
*Splat!*
The man's head bursts and he collapses.
His death is instant. There's nothing left where his head should be. Red liquid pools beneath him.
Maria-n stares blankly at the sight for a moment, then hears a Rapture and looks behind her.
A Rapture's muzzle is aimed at her head.
Maria-n opens her eyes and irritatedly leaves the room.
She goes downstairs and looks at Doctor Maria.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: Doctor.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Oh, you're awake.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: The "Commander" died.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Yeah, I know. I was watching.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: You made it 0.3% of the way. That's technically a new record, albeit in the wrong direction. Not since the early days has it gone that poorly.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: I don't think this will work.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Everything starts like that. You were the same.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: It'll get better the more you do it. It's not like there's any shortage of Command—

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: A person died!

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: For me, it doesn't matter if I die! I can come back!

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: But it's different for a human! They only get one life! For them, death is the end!

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: Seriously...! I don't understand what's going on anymore!

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: The transport ship's ready. So is the next commander.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Get going.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: Doctor!

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Go!

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: Just what do you think a person's life is, Doctor?

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Expendable.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: I see.
Maria-n trudges off.
She receives the enhancement procedure and boards the transport ship.
The man seated across from her has a face that looks familiar.
The transport ship departs, and the man stares at Maria-n as he speaks.

lines.speaker: No.2
lines.text: You're my assigned Nikke?

lines.speaker: No.2
lines.text: What is it? First time seeing a commander? You're really staring.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: ... You look like him.

lines.speaker: No.2
lines.text: Like who?

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: Do you have any brothers?

lines.speaker: No.2
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: I... see...

lines.speaker: No.2
lines.text: Huh...? You're kind of weird for a Nikke.

lines.speaker: No.2
lines.text: Anyway, let's talk strategy.

lines.speaker: No.2
lines.text: Our objective is to reach the target location, right?

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: No.2
lines.text: Do you know anything about it?

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: No.2
lines.text: Yeah, I figured. At the briefing, it felt like they were desperately trying to hide any intel about it.

lines.speaker: No.2
lines.text: I guess you don't know much about the surrounding environment either?

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: Only that there are a lot of Raptures.

lines.speaker: No.2
lines.text: Hmm... This seems a bit rough for a first deployment.

lines.speaker: No.2
lines.text: All the same, we've got to give it our best shot.

lines.speaker: No.2
lines.text: Honestly, I only graduated from the academy yesterday. I basically know nothing about actual combat.

lines.speaker: No.2
lines.text: So I'll follow your lead. I'll do whatever you say, no complaints.

lines.speaker: No.2
lines.text: I may not look it, but I'm in pretty good shape, so I shouldn't drag you down too much.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: ... You're very... realistic.

lines.speaker: No.2
lines.text: Yeah. On the battlefield, listening to a veteran is your safest bet.

lines.speaker: No.2
lines.text: I only have one favor to ask.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: A favor?

lines.speaker: No.2
lines.text: Yeah. If everything goes well, I want to take the credit.

lines.speaker: No.2
lines.text: We can say it all worked out because of my taking charge.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: That's fine by me, but... why?

lines.speaker: No.2
lines.text: I want to get ahead.

lines.speaker: No.2
lines.text: I want to rise up the ranks and become someone who has influence over the entire Ark.

lines.speaker: No.2
lines.text: Ideally, I'd like to become a deputy chief.

lines.speaker: No.2
lines.text: I'd like you to be my first step in that journey.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: Is that right? Your first step...

lines.speaker: No.2
lines.text: Yeah. Once I get higher up, I won't be dealing with ordinary Nikkes anyway.

lines.speaker: No.2
lines.text: Oh, but if you perform beyond my expectations, I would of course consider keeping you as my assigned Nikke.

lines.speaker: No.2
lines.text: Now, you ready to start climbing the ladder?
